batch_node.name: Anchore dimensions
batch_node.description: Dimension nodes for every dimension key the anchore plugin declares, so each key has a declared node before the dimension map moves to keying by node id (tap#711).

node.name: anchore.area
node.description: Which part of Anchore an entity belongs to: image, finding, policy, run, runtime, annotation or inventory.

node.name: anchore.instance
node.description: Which Anchore instance and account an Anchore-owned entity was read from. The value is the scanner key: the instance's canonical API root and the account, as a compact JSON array. Open: one value per instance and account. Stamped only on this plugin's own node types, never on a shared one.
